findings.title: Reflected XSS via onfocus/autofocus bypass
findings.description: The application reflects user input from the 'name' parameter without proper sanitization. HTML tags and event handlers are filtered, but the filter can be bypassed using onfocus event with autofocus attribute and string concatenation to bypass the 'XSS' string filter.

reproduction.expected: Page returns success_triangle with flag when XSS payload executes
